## Agent harness

This project may use a Manager, Lead, Worker harness (see `.harness/PROTOCOL.md`).

If the user pastes a BOOT.md or says "Read ... BOOT.md and follow it", open that file and follow it. Use the harness command written at its top for `send` and `inbox`. Otherwise ignore the harness.

If this project has a second brain (a `wiki/` folder), read `CLAUDE.md` (the constitution) first, then your role card.
